Chapter 9 - Desktop Manager / Desktop Manager Reference

Data Structure

You can manipulate the desktop database with a set of low-level routines that follow
the parameter-block conventions used by the File Manager. (For more information on parameter blocks, see the chapter "File Manager" in Inside Macintosh: Files.) This section describes the parameter block you pass to Desktop Manager routines.
